payload.title: Plant Coordinator
payload.description: The Plant Coordinator provides site-based operational assurance for the Facility by supervising, monitoring and coordinating the daily activities of the Facility and the services performed by the EPC and/or Operations and Maintenance (O&M) Contractors on site.

payload.title: Cash Processor Contractor
payload.description: Purpose of the Position Responsible for the efficient and accurate end to end processing of cash in compliance with policies and procedures (SOPs). A Cash Processor may perform any one and/or a combination of the functions below.

payload.title: Trainer
payload.description: The Aurum Institute is a proudly African organisation whose mission is to generate evidence for policy and translate policy into practice to positively impact the health of communities globally.
